Default: :540 `use_sandbox: Optional[bool] = True`; :569-573 `if use_sandbox is True and not _prime_sandboxes_configured(): raise RuntimeError("Prime Sandboxes not configured...")`. load.log shows that RuntimeError.
audit.user_impact: The default path fails loudly without PRIME_API_KEY. Only users who pass use_sandbox=False (or use_sandbox=None without creds) get a 1-row dummy with a free 1.0 reward. Note: default num_tasks=1 (line 528), so the default eval covers a single task.
